answers.text: "Weekly is LH but HL, not HH/HL": fair, my wording was loose. My weekly test is the tide: W close above EMA9 92.52 over EMA21 88.76, HL intact, so permission stands. D at the high, no retrace to ma_20, so timing moves to WAIT. `mp` 86.0 FADING is only a default label.

decisions.wrong_if: `elder` falls to 1 or less (red), or a daily close under the 20-day average less half an ATR.
decisions.reason: `elder` 10.0 after a 1 to 7 permission bar two sessions ago, not re-imposed. `mp` 48.0 BUILDING keeps it early; `flow` 90.8 backs it. Weekly tide up, daily swing LH/LL so I buy the dip, not the high.
